input: 我有 iris.csv 数据集,请帮我绘制各品种花萼长度与花瓣长度的散点图,保存为 PNG。

args.code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
df = pd.read_csv('iris.csv')
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
for species, group in df.groupby('species'):
    ax.scatter(group['sepal_length'], group['petal_length'], label=species)
ax.set_xlabel('sepal_length')
ax.set_ylabel('petal_length')
ax.legend()
plt.savefig('outputs/iris_scatter.png')

expected_output: 已绘制各品种花萼长度与花瓣长度散点图,保存至 outputs/iris_scatter.png。
